_comment: TATAR Triage IOC feed. Pass with -IOCFile <file> (Windows) or --ioc <file> (Linux). Values matched against collected processes, network, hashed binaries and the timeline. Offline only. hashes[] must be SHA-256 (64 hex chars, case-insensitive); MD5/SHA-1 are not compared. The sample hash is the SHA-256 of the EICAR test file, so you can test a hit safely - replace it with real IOCs.
